text: {"findings":[{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Unsourced churn and savings claims","detail":"The claim that late deliveries are the single biggest churn reason and would save millions per year is stated as fact with no source or analysis.","evidence_quote":"Late deliveries are the single biggest reason customers churn, and fixing them would save the business millions every year.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite the churn attribution analysis and the savings model, or remove or soften the claim."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"No personal data or privacy review recorded","detail":"Agents will phone customers using their contact details, which is personal data use and possibly subject to call-consent and contact regulations. The Reviews section records only contact center staffing and no privacy or legal review.","evidence_quote":"Contact center has agreed to staff a pilot team.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Record privacy/legal review covering phone contact consent, call recording, and data handling before launch."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Guardrails limited to cost","detail":"The proposal changes customer contact behavior and offers reschedules, but only Cost Per Delivery is guarded. There are no guardrails on reschedule or cancellation rates, contact complaints or opt-outs, or delivery completion and on-time performance.","evidence_quote":"Cost Per Delivery: stop if it rises by more than $0.15.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails such as cancellation rate, customer complaint or contact opt-out rate, and on-time delivery rate."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment shorter than 14 days is not the issue, but the design has gaps","detail":"The 3-week duration is fine, but the success metric target window is 8 weeks, which does not match the 3-week experiment. Customer-level randomization may also leak, because the same agents handle both arms and customers in a household may be split across arms.","evidence_quote":"Randomized by customer. Duration: 3 weeks.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Align the experiment duration with the metric measurement window, and justify the randomization unit and the handling of leakage."}]}
